answers.core: Because this is a small internal engine function that directly operates on the node’s children array, so it fits naturally as part of the core API.
answers.workaround:
Yes, it can be worked around with a few lines:
```gdscript
for i in get_children(): i.queue_free()
```

But the point is that this pattern appears a lot in real projects, and a built-in function would reduce repetition and avoid manually writing the same loop in multiple scripts.
